newsitem.title: UK: Winds expected to slow at Algeria port - forecaster.
newsitem.headline: Winds expected to slow at Algeria port - forecaster.

text.p: Winds are expected to slow on Thursday and Friday at Algeria's Skikda port before a cold front moves in over the weekend and conditions worsen, forecaster Weather Services Corp (WSC) said on Wednesday.
Skikda was closed late Tuesday because of bad weather and it was not yet known when it would reopen, a shipping agent said.

Winds are likely to be 15-20 miles per hour from the west and northwest on Wednesday and then drop to 10-15 mph on Thursday and 5-10 mph on Friday, said Joel Burgio, senior meteorologist at WSC in Lexington, Massachusetts.
"It's light to moderate winds (expected on Thursday and Friday)...and that shouldn't be enough to affect shipping operations," he added.
"Today there could be problems," he said. "After today there should not be any significant problems...but we have the cold front moving through and that tends to freshen the winds up."
"For the weekend, a cold front is moving through on Saturday and this will strengthen the winds again and there is a chance for scattered showers and that may generate a few problems," Burgio said
"On Sunday, winds will continue brisk out of the north and then diminish again on Monday."
